title: always select one radio by default
rule: Always select one radio by default (users cannot return to “none”). Dual-cite with GOV.UK no-preselect-on-questions and Polar default-when-possible: satisfy “always one selected” with explicit None when none is valid — do not force a guessed answer.

citation.source: NN/g — Radio Buttons: Select One by Default

pass_when: The radio set has a selected value. If “none” is valid, that value is an explicit None. Settings: current/safe default.
fail_when: No selected radio (stuck with no way back to none, or an empty set); or a guessed real answer is preselected on a question where none/unknown is valid; or a global always/never with no question-vs-settings split.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: A winner over GOV.UK questions or Polar “Select” placeholder when no logical default. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.inputs.good_defaults_smart_prefills`.
